_about: Edgar Allan Poe's tales, poems and criticism not already on another shelf (the reading-list poe shelf holds the rest): every English text under the name at Gutenberg that no other shelf holds. Added 2026-10-17 at the coordinator's relay of Adam's keep-going message (Adam may veto). Dates are as each title page gives them; many texts are undated. Bloom addition 2026-11-03 (Bloom's Western Canon): poe-complete-works, poe-virginia-edition-vol-xvi.

poe-complete-works.case: The Virginia Edition's five Literary Criticism volumes (VIII-XII) plus Marginalia (XVI) are the fullest pre-1931 Poe criticism. The held Raven Edition carries only a few essays.
